pr.title: Title
pr.body: The body gets a table of every bump with a link to its release notes.
pr.splitTitle: Give each major its own PR
pr.splitWhy_one: {{count}} major bump here ({{names}}). On its own PR, a bad major can be reverted without undoing the rest.
pr.splitWhy_other: {{count}} major bumps here ({{names}}). On its own PR, a bad major can be reverted without undoing the rest.
pr.helm: Chart bumps run helm dependency update in the app's directory, because Chart.lock and the vendored charts/*.tgz are committed.
pr.autoMergeWhy: Merge as soon as the PR opens. The repo has no CI to wait for.
pr.notReady: Opening PRs needs GITHUB_TOKEN, a commit author and a github.com repo. The setup banner says which is missing.

floating-tag.title: Floating tags
floating-tag.why: These can't be checked for updates because the tag moves on its own. A pod restart can change the version with no commit.

no-tag.title: No tag
no-tag.why: An image with no tag runs whatever latest is when the pod starts.

stale-vendored-chart.title: Vendored chart older than Chart.yaml
stale-vendored-chart.why: Helm renders the chart in charts/, so the version Chart.yaml asks for never deployed. Run helm dependency update and commit charts/.

unpinned-chart.title: Chart dependency with no version
unpinned-chart.why: Helm takes whatever is newest when the lock is rebuilt.

chart-range.title: Version range instead of a pin
chart-range.why: Chart.lock holds the real version. The range is fine if the lock is committed.

appversion-drift.title: Chart.yaml appVersion disagrees with the image tag
appversion-drift.why: The values.yaml tag is what runs. The appVersion label is stale, so Argo's UI and anything reading the chart shows the wrong version.

renovate-hint.title: Renovate hint names the wrong image
renovate-hint.why: Renovate looks up the image in the comment, not the one that runs.

not-a-workload.title: Not a workload
not-a-workload.why: Nothing is pinned here, so there's nothing to update.

rwo-rolling-update.title: Rolling update on a ReadWriteOnce volume
rwo-rolling-update.why: The new pod starts before the old one stops. If it lands on another node it can't attach the volume, and the rollout hangs until someone steps in. Recreate stops the old pod first. homarr hung like this on 2026-09-23.

scans.scheduleWhy: Cron expression in {{tz}}. Each scan pulls the repo, reads every app and asks each registry and Helm repo for newer versions.
